2610.08350.title: How Much Planning Is Enough? Reducing Search and Computation in World-Model Planning
2610.08350.paper_summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed control through decision-time action search, but their deployment efficiency is often limited by conservatively large planning budgets. We show that competitive task performance can be achieved without agreement with the Full-budget action, that sufficient budgets vary across model--task pairs, and that iterative planners repeatedly encode solve-invariant context. To address these inefficiencies, we propose {SufficientPlan}, a simple deployment framework that requires no modification to pretrained world models or planner updates. Its {Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC)} component uses paired closed-loop evidence to search for and certify a reduced model--task-specific budget within a predefined Full-performance tolerance. Its {Static-Context Reuse (SCR)} component caches observation and goal representations across search iterations while preserving candidate-dependent planning and selected actions. Experiments across multiple world-model backbones and visual-control tasks show that SufficientPlan substantially reduces search budgets and planning latency while maintaining competitive control performance.
2610.08350.paper_summary_zh: 視覺世界模型透過決策時間的行動搜尋實現目標導向控制，但其部署效率常常受到保守的大規劃預算的限制。我們展示了在不與全預算行動達成一致的情況下也能實現競爭性任務表現，且足夠的預算在模型與任務對之間有所不同，迭代規劃者反覆編碼解決不變的上下文。為了解決這些低效率問題，我們提出了 {SufficientPlan}，這是一個簡單的部署框架，無需對預訓練的世界模型或規劃者進行修改。其 {Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC)} 組件利用配對的閉環證據來搜尋並認證在預定的全性能容忍範圍內的減少模型-任務特定預算。其 {Static-Context Reuse (SCR)} 組件在搜尋迭代中緩存觀察和目標表示，同時保留候選依賴的規劃和選定的行動。在多個世界模型骨幹和視覺控制任務的實驗中，SufficientPlan 顯著減少了搜尋預算和規劃延遲，同時保持了競爭性的控制表現。
